ModMetaData.name: Unlocked Schematics
ModMetaData.author: VitaKaninen
ModMetaData.description:
Research schematics are never generated for a handful of research projects that vanilla hides behind a second unlock step - the Biotech mechtech line, the Odyssey gravtech line, and every Royalty project that needs a techprint.
This mod lets schematics generate for those projects too. The unlock requirement itself is untouched: a pawn can read a schematic and bank research progress toward a gated project, but the project still cannot be completed at the bench until the techprint is applied, a mechanitor joins the colony, or a grav engine is inspected.
TEST BUILD - this build contains the def patch only (mechtech + gravtech). The techprint patch and the research-gate safeguard are not included yet, so a schematic read to 100% CAN currently complete a gated project. Not intended for a real playthrough.
